LanguageData.VPEH_Hemosage.description: 吸血者是血液魔法的大师，他们使用血原作为资源来施放独特的心灵术。
LanguageData.VPEH_Hemosage.label: 止血剂
LanguageData.VPEH_Hemosage.tooltip: 吸血者是强大的年长灵能师，他们利用与邪恶引擎的联系和血腥诅咒来造成痛苦并以卑鄙、邪恶的方式操纵物质。 Relying on hemogen, they can drain and leech life from everyone around them, instilling incredible 疼痛 and even worse nightmares. Only those that have access to the power of hemogen can become a true hemosage.
